body:
25-C NBOMe
previous experience: LSD ~20x, p. semilanceata/other shrooms ~20x, Salvia ~ 1 stronger trip on 5x extract, DXM (~5 times), DOx(1x), 2ct7 (1x, on a gig, so nothing special, wrong setup), 2ci (2x), 2cb (2x), Amanitas (6 times), MXE (~20x, doses <50mg), ketamine (Small amount 1x), GHB/GBL ~150ml in lifetime, Amphetamines (If I'm using, I'm using ~20mg or less), Black-market Ecstasy (~40times in lifetime), MDMA (~10times), MDPV/MDPK (~3 times), MCPP (or something, whatever.. piperazines about 2 times at all, huge shit). 25-C NBOMe 1 time before - liquid insufflated, ~350-400ug (maybe 500ug) for test, 2 persons.
About 500-700ug taken intranasally (liquid solution), 3 trippers and few persons leaving us. After few beers in my case (about 3-4 beers and 2 whiskey drinks before), a lot of not so good cannabis&hash smoked. Begins quickly, about 5 minutes to feel strong effects.
I was shocked by first few minutes, and little panic occured. Unable to speak for few seconds, generally very hard to concentrate. I was happy that I know what I'm doing. That was quite overwhelming experience, maybe not for the people or set&setting. Lasts about 4h. Then I'm experiencing heavy insomnia, massive headache, because of cigarettes and alc i think. I'm trying to smoke some weed and sleep but it not works. After that I'm confused - that was a little waste because of alcohol and hard setting - tired after drinking beer and eating sushi; ) Substance quite interesting, ideas in mind seems to be simpler  than on LSD, but also I don't remember so much. I remember for example, that I was very tired after 4h, and when I was changing music on computer, everything looked like compressed images on web: everything seems to be little distorted, not clear.
I prefer LSD definitely, but that seems to be even stronger and less controllable sometimes!
